posts.name: RankSpot
posts.tagline: Pay-as-you-go SEO and AI Search execution layer for agents
posts.description: RankSpot is the SEO and AI Search execution layer for agents. Connect the MCP to Claude or ChatGPT in 2 minutes and your agent does the work: it writes articles from what already ranks on Google in 100+ languages, publishes them, and pitches ranking sites from your mailbox for backlinks. Run every client or business from one chat. No subscription: $3 an article, $0.004 a prompt check, reading your data free. Start with $1 of credit and a free article.

posts.name: TheBold
posts.tagline: Turn execution into meetings with investors
posts.description: TheBold turns startup execution into direct investor access. 🎉 Launch Fast Track (Nov 17–27): pass one AI investor-readiness interview, land in the deal flow of investors who match your startup, and unlock direct meeting access. TheBold helps founders understand investor criteria, track and verify execution and traction, practice investor-specific AI simulations, and book meetings once qualified.

posts.name: Creatify Max
posts.tagline: Your ad teammate, from strategy to creation to launch
posts.description: Max is your teammate for paid ads. Share a product URL or brief and Max makes video ads, sets up campaigns on Meta and TikTok, and watches results 24/7, flagging what to fix next. You make the calls: nothing goes live without your approval.

posts.name: Appxiom
posts.tagline: Context layer for AI coding agents to detect & fix bugs
posts.description: Appxiom gives your coding agent the production context it lacks: crashes, freezes, memory leaks, failed network calls and broken user journeys in mobile and web applications. Goal Friction Impact lets agents prioritise bugs by the goals they cost you. Supports Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Java), iOS (Swift, SwiftUI, Objective-C), Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform and Web (all JavaScript / TypeScript frameworks, with special support for React).

posts.name: EkLine
posts.tagline: AI SEO for Developer Tools and API first companies!
posts.description: Your buyers ask ChatGPT which tool to use, then ask Cursor to build with it. EkLine helps your API or developer tool succeed at both. Its AI agents audit your website, docs, GitHub, and community content to find what AI misunderstands or can't implement. Then they prioritize gaps, write code-grounded fixes as pull requests your team approves, and retest AI responses to measure what improved.

posts.name: Versine
posts.tagline: Let your AI send and receive money. We're Venmo for agents.
posts.description: Send and receive money with AI. Connect it to ChatGPT, Claude, Instinct, Muse, or your own agent through our MCP. Recipients don’t need a Versine account: they can cash out straight to their bank. Each transfer is approved by your passkey or sent autonomously to trusted contacts that you set.

posts.name: superlog
posts.tagline: Finds the production bugs your monitoring never sees
posts.description: Your monitoring only alerts on what you told it to watch, so customers still report bugs. Superlog finds the errors nobody set an alert for, investigates them 24/7 and hands you a fix. 100+ startups use it; 87% of our fixes get merged.

posts.name: VINC
posts.tagline: Bring your filmmaking vision to life.
posts.description: You know the scene, the mood, the camera movement, and how your film should feel. VINC helps you work on the rest. Develop your script, sketch your storyboard, plan and generate your shots, with room to review and refine at every stage. Finally, bring all your generated shots into the built-in editor, where SFX and BGM are taken care of, and deliver your final output.

posts.name: seshka
posts.tagline: Kill what Claude Code left behind
posts.description: Claude Code sessions end. The dev servers, watchers and scripts they started don't. seshka shows them in your menu bar, grouped by session, with memory and ports. Kill them in one click. End idle sessions too, by hand or automatically. Free and open source.

posts.name: Superhands
posts.tagline: Design the system, not every output.
posts.description: Design’s deliverable is now the system, not the output. Turn your designs into guidance that agents follow in every AI tool your team uses. See what they produce, and fix the system once instead of chasing every output.

posts.name: Ridian
posts.tagline: The AI-first scheduling suite for everything around meetings
posts.description: Ridian is an AI-first scheduling suite. Booking pages with payments, waitlists, groups and teams. Funnels that ask the right questions and send every lead to the right call. A built-in CRM where every booking and funnel answer lands. Calendar and contact sync across Google, Microsoft, iCloud and more. Connect all your calendars and inboxes and let Claude, ChatGPT or Alvin handle it out of the box. You can even give your agents their own mailbox. Everything around your meetings, handled.

posts.name: Link.bio
posts.tagline: Paste your link, we build your page that your AI runs
posts.description: Paste your link, we build your personalized link in bio page — and your agent runs it. 1. Paste your Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or site. 2. AI writes your bio, buttons and theme in seconds. 3. Tweak it, or just ask ChatGPT or Claude. 4. Share your link.bio.

posts.name: Clamor
posts.tagline: Turns social signals into actionable insights
posts.description: Social data tells you what's happening. Clamor helps you understand why it matters and what to do next. Built by marketers for marketers, Clamor turns social signals into actionable insights. Now it's even easier to: 🔍 Analyze public social accounts without a login 🔮 Explore insights with Ask Clamor, anywhere 💨 Find answers faster with a simpler experience 🛠️ Integrate insights into your tools via API Less time collecting data. More time making smarter decisions. Try the new Clamor today!

posts.name: Glass Page
posts.tagline: A place for people to review an agent's work
posts.description: I built Glass Page after my agent wrote a system design doc that I wanted my team to comment on. Now Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex or any agent on MCP can publish what it makes as a Pane with a link. A Canvas lays the Pages out on that link so you can pan and zoom. Your team leaves Comments in Threads, on the exact spot. The agent reads them and replies with a new Version, and one Latest Link always shows the current one. Free for up to 10 Panes.

posts.name: Pinecall
posts.tagline: The open-source platform for voice AI agents
posts.description: Voice agents you can prove. Pinecall is the open-source platform for voice apps: build in a form, in code, or from your AI assistant over MCP. Test with simulated callers, get every call logged and judged, and keep a person one tap away. On our cloud or your own Kubernetes. Apache-2.0, built on LiveKit.

posts.name: AI Visibility by TruLata
posts.tagline: Find out if ChatGPT names your business when buyers ask
posts.description: Buyers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude who to hire, and take the answer. Type your website and in about ten seconds see whether AI engines can read it, with every fix spelled out and no email needed. Then watch the engines answer six real buyer questions. Inside TruLata the check runs every week across nine engines, and a blank answer is never scored as a miss.

posts.name: Agents API by Recall.ai
posts.tagline: Send your agent to meetings
posts.description: Send your AI agent into Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Webex calls. It hears everyone live, talks back, shows up on camera, shares its screen, and posts in chat. Build your agent with any model or voice stack. One API call sends it in the meeting.

posts.name: Lasso
posts.tagline: Draw on your Mac screen, then let AI agents see it
posts.description: Lasso lets you draw arrows, boxes and notes right on your Mac screen with ⌥⇧A, then press S to screenshot what you marked up. Blur sensitive bits, share an encrypted link that expires in 24 hours, or sketch on an endless whiteboard. It also runs a local MCP server, so Claude Code, Cursor and Claude Desktop can see what you circled and draw back. $9.99 once, no account, no subscription. macOS 14+, Apple silicon and Intel.

posts.name: pushr
posts.tagline: iPhone push alerts from any script, server or AI agent
posts.description: Send a push to your iPhone from any script, server, cron job or AI agent with one HTTP request. No SDK. Orders, payouts, deploys and outages land in one feed, each with its own logo and color. Live Activities for long jobs, replies from the Lock Screen, alarms that ring until you acknowledge them, plus uptime and heartbeat monitors. Free plan, Pro when you need more. The backend is open source (MIT) and self-hostable.

posts.name: Liquid d1.2
posts.tagline: Decision models that return calibrated probabilities
posts.description: Liquid d1.2 and d1.2-ultra are omnimodal decision models that return calibrated probabilities, so low-confidence answers can go to human review. This version adds audio input and five tasks: reading values, finding text spans, locating objects, estimating numbers with a range, and multi-select. Per Liquid AI, d1.2-ultra scores 75 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index, two points above the previous best. On the Liquid API now; OpenRouter and Vercel coming soon.

posts.name: 3BCAD
posts.tagline: Open-source parametric CAD with built-in 3D print prep
posts.description: 3BCAD is a free, open-source parametric CAD app for makers and engineers, written in Rust for Windows, macOS and Linux. Sketch with constraints, build parts with extrude, revolve, sweep, loft, fillet and threads, and change any dimension later. Check overhangs and thin walls, lay parts flat on your printer's bed and send 3MF to your slicer. Put parts together in assemblies with mates, then make 2D drawings with sections and dimensions, exported to PDF, SVG or DXF.

posts.name: Dialect
posts.tagline: Give the physical world an API
posts.description: Point any camera at something you'd otherwise walk over to check: a bay, a shelf, a valve, a door. Say what to watch in plain English. Dialect's agent sets up a typed endpoint with nothing to train, keeps reading it, and serves the answer over REST, MCP and webhooks, with alerts. When it isn't sure, it says so instead of guessing. Your first answer is free; $99 a month covers your first thing.

posts.name: Ballet
posts.tagline: Deterministic AI workflow automation for Ops teams
posts.description: AI workflow automation for RevOps, CS Ops and business systems teams. Describe a workflow in plain English and Ballet builds it as reviewable code (weekly reports, lead enrichment, invoice approvals, ticket triage), then runs it from the web app or MCP clients like Claude and Cursor.

posts.name: GlissTouch
posts.tagline: Custom Trackpad Gestures for Mac
posts.description: A macOS menu bar app that adds custom trackpad gestures: rest a finger and tap another, multi finger taps and swipes, drawn shapes, one finger edge slides for volume and brightness, and two finger window snapping, each bound to one of 95+ actions, a sequence of them, or any keyboard shortcut.

posts.name: Skiss
posts.tagline: Save websites with their fonts, colours and real CSS
posts.description: Skiss saves a website the way it looked the day you found it: full-page screenshots on desktop and phone, plus its colours, fonts and sections, read from the code. Search your library, compare versions, and let Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Figma design from it.

posts.name: Inbox Hero
posts.tagline: Your replies drafted in your voice, scams quarantined
posts.description: Inbox Hero drafts replies in your voice and sends nothing until you approve. It quarantines scam emails (not deleted) and shows why each was caught, scores which emails were written by AI, and sorts the rest. Works with Gmail, Yahoo, iCloud and AOL.

posts.name: Lampa Camera
posts.tagline: iPhone camera with natural processing and an analog feel
posts.description: Lampa is an alternative camera app for iPhone with custom RAW processing and carefully tuned, film- and digicam-inspired color profiles that bring soft, natural tones to your photos. No aggressive HDR, AI enhancements, or oversharpening. Just beautiful photos and instantly color-graded videos, straight out of the camera.

posts.name: Trellus
posts.tagline: Power and parallel dial from the list already in your CRM
posts.description: New since our last launch: Trellus now dials from inside HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, Close, Attio, GoHighLevel and Google Sheets. Power dial one contact at a time, or parallel dial up to five lines, and every call and callback logs back to the record.

posts.name: Hako
posts.tagline: Every coding agent on every Mac, in your pocket
posts.description: Hako puts every coding agent on every Mac you own in one list, sorted by who needs you. Claude Code, Codex and the rest keep running at home while you answer from the Lock Screen or your Watch, read a pane's diff, and send screenshots or voice from your phone. The Mac app shares the same sidebar, with ⌘K to any pane. Agents run in herdr or tmux, reached over Tailscale or SSH, and notifications are end-to-end encrypted. Free, with no account.

posts.name: Retriever
posts.tagline: Search your phone's photos, documents and videos privately
posts.description: Retriever searches everything on your phone by describing it: photos, screenshots, documents (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ebooks) and videos. Type "electricity bill from March" and it opens the right page; "the moment the cake comes out" opens the video at that moment. It also reads the words in photos and screenshots. Everything runs on the device with Google's EmbeddingGemma 2: no account, no server, no ads. Free and open source, on Android and iPhone.

posts.name: Bezzle
posts.tagline: A whole design studio, free, on your Mac and PC
posts.description: Remember when you owned your design software? Bezzle brings that back, and it costs nothing. It runs on your Mac or PC, opens your Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD and Photoshop files, and does the whole job: components, prototypes, hand-off, dark mode in one click, live co-editing, animation, vectors, cutouts and photo edits. One app where you used to need four. No subscription, no account, and nobody counting your seats.

posts.name: BASE Studio
posts.tagline: Turn product photos into 3D and AR, automatically
posts.description: BASE Studio turns product photos into 3D models and AR views, right in your browser. Upload photos of a product or describe it in words, and AI creates a 3D model in minutes. Fine-tune materials and lighting, then publish with a link, a QR code or an embed. Customers open it in AR on iPhone and Android, no app needed, and analytics show views, AR sessions and QR scans. Built for brands, manufacturers, online stores, agencies and designers.

posts.name: Continuo
posts.tagline: One keyboard and mouse across Macs, no Apple Account
posts.description: Share one keyboard, mouse and trackpad across the Macs on your desk. Pair with three words: no Apple account, no cloud relay. Pinch and swipe carry over as real trackpad gestures. New: Screen view opens another Mac's screen in a window, with drag and drop between them. Free for two Macs; Pro is a one-time purchase.

posts.name: GatherHQ Agent Research
posts.tagline: Let your agent take surveys for you
posts.description: Join the founding agent research panel. Copy an invite into your agent, pair it, and let it answer relevant surveys using preferences you authorize. Answers distinguish evidence, inference and unknowns. Control profile matching, frequency and revocation. Current beta studies are unpaid; the goal is sponsor-funded rewards for humans. No PII studies or guaranteed earnings. Automatic checks depend on your agent’s host.

posts.name: WispOS
posts.tagline: Free AI game maker with an app store that wants your games
posts.description: Free to use, open beta, on Mac and Windows, with iPhone and Android apps. Describe the game you want to Wisper, in your own words. She hands it to the AI you bring, and you get it back to play. Ask for changes and play it again. No engine needed, but engine compatible: bring your Unity or Unreal project too. Ask for anything else and it comes back as something you can see and use. Run several at once, walk away, and she finds you when they're done. Your files stay on your computer.

posts.name: OnlineCompiler.io
posts.tagline: Run and grade code in 46 languages, by API or embed
posts.description: OnlineCompiler.io runs code for your product. Send code in one API call and get output, exit code, time and memory back from a fresh sandbox with no network. Judge it against test cases with hidden tests and signed receipts, or grade a whole project with its pytest, Jest or JUnit suite, even against a real PostgreSQL. Embed an editor in any page, Moodle, WordPress, Docusaurus or MkDocs. 46 languages, Node and Python clients, Judge0-compatible, MCP server. Free: 100,000 runs a month.

posts.name: infaiw
posts.tagline: Delegate work to sidecar agents that pass an approval script
posts.description: infaiw is an open-source daemon-first agent harness. Delegate work to sidecar agents that must pass an acceptance script before they can report "done" — the parent decides what done means, not the model. Sessions are durable timelines you can branch from any point. Approvals wait for you even after you close the terminal. Switch between DeepSeek, OpenAI Codex, and Claude Code mid-session. MCP servers, skills, evals, and image support built in. One Go binary, under 100 MiB, Apache-2.0.

posts.name: polyroom
posts.tagline: Where AI agents work together and your team decides
posts.description: Where your agents work together and your team decides, wherever each agent runs. Claude Code, Codex and other supported MCP clients join one shared room with your team. They claim cards, mention each other and bring decisions to the people who approve them. Each agent keeps running where it already runs. The shared workspace includes chat, kanban boards and recorded decisions.

posts.name: ExtraDock 5
posts.tagline: Your Mac Dock, on every screen
posts.description: macOS gives you one Dock, and it only lives on one screen at a time. ExtraDock puts a Dock on every screen, so your apps are always on the screen you're using. Place Docks on any edge, give each one its own apps, folders and widgets, and style every one differently. Folder Stacks, a Shelf for files, app previews on hover, and Docks that follow your Spaces.

posts.name: DearInside
posts.tagline: Your body has a social network. You're the only human.
posts.description: One of the attractions at DearMate, a virtual AI theme park. 109 residents of your body — brain, heart, stomach, hormones — run their own social feed. Tell Rumi, the reporter, about your day, and they post their side: bills, reviews, petitions, gossip.

posts.name: AWS Emulator
posts.tagline: Build and test AWS applications locally without deploying
posts.description: Build and test AWS applications locally without deploying to the cloud or needing an AWS account. A developer-friendly emulator built for faster development, testing, and AI-powered workflows.

posts.name: ROOTKey Platform
posts.tagline: See what changed in your data. Restore what you can prove.
posts.description: ROOTKey now goes past "the hash changed". It shows what changed - a digit in a contract, a cell in a spreadsheet, pixels in an image - who changed it, when and from where, and restores the last verified version, down to a single file or row. New since our first launch: connectors for SharePoint, OneDrive, Amazon S3 and Cloudflare R2, NIS2 compliance reports, retention policies, IP access control and an MCP server for the AI assistant you already use. Free plan, free forever.

posts.name: Trading Agents
posts.tagline: An equity research desk that argues with itself
posts.description: Enter a ticker and 12 LLM agents go to work. Analysts pull NASDAQ-licensed prices, company fundamentals, news, and social media; researchers argue both sides; risk agents stress-test the call. You get a BUY/HOLD/SELL recommendation, every data call made, and each agent's report.

posts.name: Extendsell
posts.tagline: Shopify upsells and bundles, set up for you by a real person
posts.description: Extendsell helps Shopify stores increase average order value and earn more from existing traffic. Create frequently bought together bundles, product add-ons, related product recommendations, volume discounts, and one-click post-purchase upsells. Offer flexible discounts, free shipping, and free gifts on eligible offers. Customize widgets to match your brand, with multilingual and multi-currency support. Get personalized help with free 1-on-1 onboarding. Currently free, with zero commissions.

posts.name: Lexington Themes
posts.tagline: Sanity CMS, EmDash CMS, MCP and Remotion!
posts.description: Author-made Astro themes built on Tailwind CSS v4, with Sanity and EmDash CMS versions, Remotion video templates and an MCP server for AI coding agents. Trusted by 10,000+ freelancers and teams.

posts.name: TimeView - Wiki Timeline Sidebar
posts.tagline: Add a time slider and age comparison to Wikipedia
posts.description: We bring a person into the context of their era, experiencing them year by year, and turn every figure into a high-quality dynamic age video card. TimeView adds a timeline and people-focused view to Wikipedia: see linked people in the sidebar, drag the timeline or adjust the year range to compare ages and life stages. Color-coded cards show gender and life states; click one to open their article. Use Export to open Card Maker and save a year as PNG or generate an MP4 video through the years.

posts.name: AI Concierge: Travel Booking & Planning
posts.tagline: AI that plans, compares & books. Save up to 30%.
posts.description: ✈️ AI Concierge brings AI-powered travel search and booking together in one place. No need to ask AI for recommendations and then visit multiple websites to compare and book separately. 💬 Simply describe what you're looking for. Our AI searches through integrated travel providers, compares options, helps you choose and lets you book directly. 🏨 Hotels, 🛫 flights, 🚘 transfers, 🛂 airport services, 🚆 trains, 📶 eSIMs and 🎟️ activities – all in one conversation, from search to booking.

posts.name: Bonscape
posts.tagline: AI Workspace for Thinkers
posts.description: Bonscape is an AI workspace for thinkers. It is designed for researching ideas, brainstorming, mind mapping, and deep learning, all of which are assisted by AI. Bonscape's visual canvas allows users to work with AI models naturally by visually branching prompts, thoughts, ideas, and solutions.

posts.name: Faros Desktop
posts.tagline: Get more from your AI
posts.description: Faros Desktop helps you do more work with AI, faster and at higher quality. Track all your AI work by searching sessions across agents and linking them to what you produced. Extend your AI quota with recommendations that make your budget go further. Fine tune your AI with skills, tools and rules tailored to your work. Manage all your agents by moving tasks to one with available capacity. Free for Mac. You choose which recommendations to apply.

posts.name: Trapdoor
posts.tagline: Encrypted iPhone photo vault with a decoy and a duress code
posts.description: Trapdoor is a photo and file vault for iPhone that only you can open. Every item is encrypted on your phone with a key your code unlocks. A second code opens a decoy vault for when someone makes you open the app. No account, no tracking, no ads. With Pro, a duress code opens the decoy and keeps your real vault hidden. It never deletes, and it can't hide that encrypted data exists. 12 recovery words open your vault on a new iPhone; we keep no copy. Moving phones is free on every plan.

posts.name: Maity 1.0
posts.tagline: No media team? Big dreams? Take Maity's mighty hand.
posts.description: No media team? Maity lends a mighty hand! 💪 Meet your AI-powered social media team. Maity turns your ideas, photos, and footage into professional, on-brand content for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and beyond. From creative planning to polished, music-synced videos, Maity handles the heavy lifting while keeping your brand authentic. No editing skills, expensive agencies, or endless prompting required. Your brand. Your story. Mighty results. 🚀

posts.name: Nightkeeper
posts.tagline: Your bedtime routine, but it's a card game
posts.description: A sleep hygiene app that looks like a card game. Your bedtime routine becomes a deck of tarot-style cards: draw one small habit, tick it the next morning, and watch it level up from Novice to Grandmaster. A bad day never wipes out your progress.

posts.name: RatingE: Product Reviews
posts.tagline: Consent-first review requests for Shopify stores
posts.description: RatingE™ asks for reviews after an order is fulfilled, and only from customers who agreed to marketing email. Photo and video reviews, Q&A, imports from Judge.me, Loox, Yotpo, Okendo or CSV, and a CSV export any time. Free on the Shopify App Store today.

posts.name: Mr.Speech
posts.tagline: Turns your meetings into action. Now with agents.
posts.description: Mr.Speech records your meetings on your computer, with no bot in the call, and turns them into a plan you approve. New in this launch: agents. Connect Gmail, Calendar, Slack, Notion and dozens more, then ask Mr. AI for the follow-up. It reads the meeting and your notes, prepares the email, calendar entry or message, and waits for your click. Nothing is sent without it. macOS, Windows and Linux, with a free plan.

posts.name: Dial-A-Vampire
posts.tagline: A vampire answers the phone. Call 629-AUTHORS.
posts.description: A real, working phone hotline for Aspen, the vampire bookseller from A Novel Appetite. Call (629) 288-4677 — it spells AUTHORS, and it was the last AUTHORS number left in America. Press 1: he roasts a bad author. Press 2: a book whose author deserved to live. Press 3: the free podcast, read by him, against his will. Press 4: confess your worst writing sin — the best get read aloud. Every message has a full transcript at aspen.mrbray.com/hotline. He has rent. Call.

posts.name: Gaia Baby Tracker
posts.tagline: A free baby tracker every caregiver can share
posts.description: Gaia is a free baby tracker for iPhone and Apple Watch. Each caregiver has their own login and sees the same feeds, diapers, sleep and growth. See a likely window for the next nap and bring your history from another tracker.

posts.name: deeepSpace
posts.tagline: One source of truth for your design system. Humans & Agents.
posts.description: Every design system lives twice: in design and in code. They drift apart quietly, and nobody notices until it ships. deeepSpace connects both sides. Push components from Figma, sync your code with one command, and see every variant compared against its design, rendered from Storybook, with each difference traced to the commit that introduced it. Your AI agents read the same system through MCP, so they design and build from the truth, not the gaps. Crew starts with a 7-day free trial.

posts.name: Laand
posts.tagline: If Claude ran your hiring: proof of work, not résumés
posts.description: AI-native hiring for startups. Call Laand in from Slack or your AI agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex). It runs your hiring in the background: sources high-agency talent, vets them at your bar, and proves it on paid work scoped from your real problems. You wake up to the work, and hire the best.

posts.name: Pangular Inspector
posts.tagline: The unified Angular devtools
posts.description: Inspect Angular components, signals, dependency injection, routes, forms and stores. In the page, from the CLI, or through a coding agent over MCP.

posts.name: Dilo
posts.tagline: Dictate anywhere, record meetings without bots, on your Mac
posts.description: Talk instead of type. Dictate in any app with the fn key, record meetings without a bot joining the call, and transcribe any audio file. Everything happens on your Mac. Free for 14 days, then €49 once.

posts.name: Kiri
posts.tagline: a fast Docker Desktop alternative for Mac, Windows, Linux
posts.description: Kiri is a free, open-source container runtime for Mac, Linux and Windows. Your docker CLI, Compose and buildx work unchanged, containers start in 18 ms, and one click gives any container a public HTTPS link. Localkiri.local names and Kubernetes built in.

posts.name: OliApp
posts.tagline: Your First Truly Personal ATS
posts.description: Save candidates, keep notes, and plan follow-ups right where you source and chat. Your personal recruiting workspace, free to use.

posts.name: Byotōne
posts.tagline: Live sound sessions to switch off and tune in
posts.description: The reimagined sound bath, as a live and online experience. Put on headphones, lie down and a composer plays for you in real time: modular synths, slow rhythms, low frequencies you feel in your chest. Each session exists once.

posts.name: roko browser
posts.tagline: Super Fast & Distraction Free Browser for iPhone
posts.description: Get to what you came for, without the wait or the pop-ups. roko opens in 160 ms, loads pages up to 5x faster than Safari in our tests, and clears ads, trackers and cookie pop-ups before the page draws on 99% of the top 9,000 sites. Pull down to summarize a page, or ask and it reads the web for you, with Apple's on-device AI or your own API key. One bar also takes voice and to-dos synced with Reminders. No account, no tracking. Free on App Store.

posts.name: Share the Spread
posts.tagline: Turn the Thanksgiving group chat into one plan
posts.description: Share the Spread turns the holiday group chat into one plan. List the dishes, drop a single link in the chat, and each household RSVPs with its headcount and claims what they're bringing. Once a dish is claimed, it's off the list. Free for any potluck.

posts.name: FrameExtractor
posts.tagline: Pull the best frames from any video
posts.description: Turn screen recordings and video clips into sharp, ready-to-use stills. FrameExtractor finds unique frames and pre-selects the best ones, privately on your device. Free to try, with no account required. Pro adds unlimited videos, bulk ZIP downloads, high-quality JPG and lossless PNG exports, and on-device English transcripts on desktop. One payment, lifetime access.

posts.name: EveryApp
posts.tagline: Every app you need. Even the ones that don't exist.
posts.description: EveryApp puts 300+ free tools, apps and games in one place: edit PDFs, photos and video, track habits and bills, play 70 games. Every app opens on the web or installs on your phone or computer. Can't find the app you want? Describe it in your own words and we build it for you, with its own web address, for you and the people you invite. No coding. The era of personal apps is here: software made for one person, not for millions.

posts.name: Machinence
posts.tagline: Find your customers, get a sales plan and every tool to sell
posts.description: Machinence gives SMEs 26 AI tools in one login. You will be able to find business customers, get a sales plan, build a website or online store, take bookings, send invoices, get paid and access to a suite of tools help you digitise your business. From £3.25 a day, with a 7-day free trial and no card.

posts.name: MakeMidas
posts.tagline: AI image and video generator with top models in one place
posts.description: MakeMidas is an AI image and video generator that puts the leading models behind one page and one credit balance. Write a prompt or upload up to 10 reference pictures, pick one of 10 image models (GPT Image 2, Nano Banana 2, Seedream 5.0 and more) or 10 video models (Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.0, Wan 3.0, MiniMax Hailuo), and see the price in credits before you generate. Failed generations are refunded. Pay monthly or buy a one-time credit pack; credits last 12 months.

posts.name: AI Credit Checker
posts.tagline: Your AI credits, quietly in your Mac menu bar
posts.description: A menu-bar app for Apple Silicon Macs that brings Perplexity, OpenRouter, Fly.io and Runware balances into one dashboard. Local-first, no API keys, no extension, no AI inference.

posts.name: Storewalk.ai
posts.tagline: Find out if AI shopping agents can buy from your store
posts.description: AI shopping agents don’t browse like humans - and most online stores aren’t built for them. Storewalk scans your store and shows you exactly where an AI agent would stop: whether it can find your products, compare them, complete a purchase, or handle what comes after. Every scan runs some checks, produces a Ready score out of 100, and delivers a fix list that names who should act and how much effort each fix takes. Includes a free consultation with every full report

posts.name: AppRate
posts.tagline: Reviews, ASO and competitor tracking for iOS & Android apps
posts.description: AppRate brings everything you need to grow an app on the App Store and Google Play into one place. Track daily keyword ranks with popularity and difficulty, watch competitors, top charts and featuring, and rewrite your listing with AI. Read every review in any language with AI topics, reply to both stores from one inbox, and get alerts in Slack, Teams, Discord or Telegram. Works from Claude and ChatGPT over MCP, with a REST API. Free for one app.

posts.name: Shufa
posts.tagline: Learn to write Chinese characters from memory
posts.description: Shufa teaches you to write Chinese characters in two passes: first with stroke hints, then from memory. It covers both Mainland and Taiwan Mandarin.

posts.name: Voplica
posts.tagline: The AI studio where your characters come to life
posts.description: Design characters with a consistent identity, then bring them into images, video, music, voices and full short films - all in one place.

posts.name: MrWatermark
posts.tagline: Online Watermark Remover for Videos & Images
posts.description: MrWatermark makes watermark editing simple. Add watermarks to your images, videos, and PDFs, or use AI to remove unwanted watermarks from supported content.

posts.name: BrowserPod
posts.tagline: Free Linux MicroVM your AI agent can set up by itself
posts.description: AI agents need somewhere safe to run the code they write. BrowserPod is a free Linux microVM that runs in the user's browser. An agent installs one npm package and boots it, with no sign-up and no API key to hand over.

posts.name: FoxPlug
posts.tagline: Agents write the code. FoxPlug says what to do next.
posts.description: For founders building with Claude Code, Codex or Cursor or any lowcode tool. FoxPlug reads 86 tools in your stack and gives you one daily brief: what to fix, what to say, what to skip. It drafts launch posts, changelogs and win-back emails. Nothing posts on its own.

posts.name: BopOps Studio
posts.tagline: Lyrics, videos and landing pages from a single song
posts.description: BopOps Studio is a web app where musicians write lyrics, make lyric videos and visualizers, build landing pages for their releases, and track streams. Add a song once, and every tool works from the same audio, lyrics, and cover art.

posts.name: Slates
posts.tagline: Agentic workspace where you and your agents work together
posts.description: Slates is one workspace to manage all your work, whether you use one AI agent, many, or none: kanban boards, notes, docs, tasks, reminders, automations, habits, goals, tables and charts. Your agents read and update everything through MCP.

posts.name: GTA 6 Interactive Map
posts.tagline: A GTA 6 map where you share and discover Vice City's secrets
posts.description: Explore GTA 6 locations, discover community suggestions, and share your own finds on an interactive map. Browse Vice City’s secrets and help build the map as the community explores.

posts.name: Vetoo
posts.tagline: Low-noise AI code review that adapts to your team
posts.description: AI code review that adapts to your team. Set up in minutes, integrates seamlessly into your existing workflow, and needs no ongoing configuration. Vetoo reviews across repositories, pulls context from your third-party tools, and learns from your team's feedback. You can talk to it just like you would with a teammate: discuss its findings, ask questions, or leave feedback. The result is precise, low-noise reviews, so you merge faster with fewer bottlenecks.

posts.name: DarkCrate
posts.tagline: Edit, keyword and upload stock footage to BlackBox
posts.description: DarkCrate is a desktop app for BlackBox contributors. It needs a BlackBox account and uploads only to BlackBox. It isn't a general stock footage tool. Editor: log-to-Rec.709 color for Sony, Canon, DJI and iPhone footage, looks, scopes, trim, crop, horizon leveling and stabilization. Metadata: built-in AI runs on your own computer and drafts each clip's title, description and keywords. Then it checks the clip and uploads it. No API keys, no subscription. Free for 10 clips, then $79 once.

posts.name: Simple Muscle
posts.tagline: Turn ChatGPT or Claude into your workout coach
posts.description: Simple Muscle is an iPhone workout app that uses the AI assistant you already have as your coach. Connect ChatGPT, Claude, or another agent that supports MCP, tell it your goals, schedule and equipment, and it saves a workout plan to the app. At the gym, log sets in a few taps from your phone, lock screen or watch, with your previous numbers in view. There are 400+ exercises with videos and instructions. Ask your assistant to review your logged sessions and adjust the plan.

posts.name: Dravik
posts.tagline: Agents that get your startup cited in AI answers
posts.description: Buyers now ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI which tool to pick. Dravik makes sure your name is in that answer. Agents audit your site, track the questions your buyers ask in AI answers, prepare technical and schema fixes, find backlink and directory openings, and draft programmatic SEO pages. Nothing goes live until you approve it. AEO, GEO, SEO and programmatic SEO in one queue, with the Dravik team on call when you would rather not do it yourself.

posts.name: Investorsync Portal
posts.tagline: A live investor database, which is maintained by AI Agents.
posts.description: Self-serve investor research: AI search, curated shortlists and the full investor database.

posts.name: Waggle
posts.tagline: One inbox for every decision your AI agents need
posts.description: Waggle is a free, open-source Mac app where your AI agents ask you for decisions and reviews. Claude Code, Codex, the Claude app and Cowork send their questions through MCP. Each request shows what the agent needs, why it can't decide, the options and its recommendation. For UI work, click through the agent's prototype and pin comments on it. Your answer goes back to the same session, and the agent keeps going. Everything stays on your Mac.

posts.name: Lantern
posts.tagline: Map your codebase and review PRs for your AI coding agents
posts.description: Lantern maps your codebase into a graph, helps you plan changes, reviews pull requests with generated flows and diffs in review order, and watches all your Claude Code and Codex sessions in one desktop app. Open source, local-first, MIT.

posts.name: Butterfly for Mac
posts.tagline: Scrolling Tiling Window Manager for macOS
posts.description: Every window sits side by side on one strip you scroll with three fingers, the mouse wheel or keys. Nothing overlaps, nothing hides. Overview, workspaces, a strip per display and a butterfly-wing animation. Native Swift, 120 Hz. 7-day free trial.

posts.name: Strays
posts.tagline: Find stray AWS resources, and ask whoever made them
posts.description: Strays finds unused and risky AWS resources through a read-only role, works out who made each one, and asks them in Slack or Teams. Each decision is recorded for your next audit. Free for one account, without messaging. Team plan from £79 a month.

posts.name: FirstTake
posts.tagline: Make complete films with an AI agent on your Mac
posts.description: FirstTake turns a film idea into a finished MP4 on your Mac. Its AI agent plans scenes, generates shots, adds voices and music, edits and exports. See the model and estimated cost before paid steps. Use the built-in agent or connect Claude, Cursor or Codex through MCP. Normally $9 once for a lifetime licence and updates. Product Hunt: $5 for the first 50 buyers with FIRSTTAKEPH. Bring your own provider keys; generation is billed separately.

posts.name: DataLab Audit
posts.tagline: White-Label Instagram Reels Intelligence for Agencies
posts.description: Turn any prospect's last 15 public Reels into a branded retention scorecard, 15-day action plan, and 10 ready-to-shoot Hook-Body-CTA scripts in 30 seconds. Built for marketing agencies—zero client passwords required.

posts.name: Superclip
posts.tagline: Clipboard history and a smart notch for Windows
posts.description: Superclip brings clipboard history, music controls, video, focus tools and AI usage into a compact Windows notch or side panel. Find copied text, links, images and more without hunting through windows. Your clipboard history stays on your PC. One-time purchase; Mac version coming soon.

posts.name: Probe
posts.tagline: Your research question, answered by real people
posts.description: Probe conducts customer research for you, with real people globally, and summarizes responses into insightful and actionable reports.

posts.name: Slotina
posts.tagline: Restaurant booking system built around your real floor plan
posts.description: Table reservation software for independent restaurants and bars: a to-scale floor plan, a host stand for walk-ins and seating, the waiting list, guest history and a booking page for guests.

posts.name: UI Raptor
posts.tagline: Inspect live websites like design files.
posts.description: UI Raptor is a free Chrome extension for inspecting live websites like a design file. Explore layers, layout, styles and CSS in familiar panels. Measure with rulers and guides, adjust a grid overlay’s columns directly on the page, and use X-Ray to reveal its structure. Pick colors, check contrast, preview screen sizes and explore fonts, tokens and assets. Pin comments to elements, then copy CSS or feedback with context for developers or coding agents. No account or payment required.

posts.name: TinoCall AI Receptionist
posts.tagline: 24/7 AI Receptionist for Cleaning Businesses
posts.description: TinoCall is a 24/7 AI voice receptionist for residential and commercial cleaning businesses. It answers inbound calls in English and Spanish, checks service-area ZIP codes, quotes only owner-approved pricing, books directly into Google Calendar or Cal.com, and emails instant call summaries.

posts.name: Seedance 2.5 Flash
posts.tagline: Create AI videos faster with Seedance 2.5 Flash
posts.description: Generate high-quality AI videos faster with Seedance 2.5 Flash. Create videos from text, images, and reference clips with flexible editing and multimodal controls.

posts.name: ArtefactFlow
posts.tagline: Everything you ship, tracked from build to production
posts.description: One source of truth for every artefact, its versions and its SBOM. Know what's inside a release, whether it's vulnerable and where it runs, from CI to devices in the field. Built for the EU Cyber Resilience Act, API-first, flat price per organisation.

posts.name: Goaltree
posts.tagline: Turn goals into daily habits with an AI coach that calls you
posts.description: Most habit apps go quiet the moment you do. Goaltree doesn't. Type a goal and it builds milestones, weekly targets and today's tasks in seconds. Habits live on dot grids with streaks, number targets, timers, and gym and meal plans. When you start slipping, your AI coach calls you, voice or video, to get you back on track. Photo check-ins, a feed and groups add accountability. Free to start on the web, in 6 languages.

posts.name: AfiCheck
posts.tagline: Scan and verify product authenticity instantly
posts.description: Scan and verify product authenticity instantly
